Two neat rows of pots - the evidence of the resolved arc and Sentila's success
Her work indistinguishable from her mother's - the daughter matching the mother, which is how 689 resolves

Why she hid the desire - because her mother rejected the craft; the expectation-versus-passion clash

Onula's insight that she lacked confidence, not talent - the mentor's diagnosis that makes her guidance work
Significance for the village - the heritage safely passed to the next generation
Character sketch built on passion, struggle and ultimate triumph - the determination-through-failure arc of 684
Diary entry on discovering the rows of pots - the same discovery/resolution scene as the other items on it, written from Onula's side

Mesoba's role and his support - the family dynamic that moves the conflict to resolution
